arxiv-2110-07080.title: Extension of Period Maps by Polyhedral Fans
arxiv-2110-07080.creator: Haohua Deng
arxiv-2110-07080.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Haohua Deng. Abstract Kato and Usui developed a theory of partial compactifications for quotients of period domains D by arithmetic groups \Gamma , in an attempt to generalize the toroidal compactifications of Ash-Mumford-Rapoport-Tai to non-classical cases. Their partial compactifications, which aim to fully compactify the images of period maps, rely on a choice of fan which is strongly compatible with \Gamma .

arxiv-2111-12036.title: Quantum simulation of parity-time symmetry breaking with a superconducting quantum processor
arxiv-2111-12036.creator: Shruti Dogra, Artem A. Melnikov, Gheorghe Sorin Paraoanu
arxiv-2111-12036.description: Abstract Abstract- The observation of genuine quantum effects in systems governed by non-Hermitian Hamiltonians has been an outstanding challenge in the field. Here we simulate the evolution under such Hamiltonians in the quantum regime on a superconducting quantum processor by using a dilation procedure involving an ancillary qubit.

arxiv-2201-03452.title: Most Clicks Problem in Lights Out
arxiv-2201-03452.creator: William Boyles
arxiv-2201-03452.description: Abstract Consider a game played on a simple graph G = ( V , E ) G=(V,E) where each vertex consists of a clickable light. Clicking any vertex v v toggles the on/off state of v v and its neighbors.

arxiv-2203-06817.title: Role of electron-phonon coupling in excitonic insulator candidate Ta 2 NiSe 5
arxiv-2203-06817.creator: Cheng Chen, Xiang Chen, Weichen Tang, Zhenglu Li, Siqi Wang, Shuhan Ding, Zhibo Kang, Chris Jozwiak, Aaron Bostwick, Eli Rotenberg, Makoto Hashimoto, Donghui Lu, Jacob P.C. Ruff, Steven G. Louie, Robert J. Birgeneau, Yulin Chen, Yao Wang, Yu He
arxiv-2203-06817.description: Abstract Electron-hole bound pairs, or excitons, are common excitations in semiconductors. They can spontaneously form and “condense” into a new insulating ground state – the so-called excitonic insulator – when the energy of electron-hole Coulomb attraction exceeds the band gap. In the presence of electron-phonon coupling, a periodic lattice distortion often concomitantly occurs with this exciton condensation.

arxiv-2305-16349.title: Lexinvariant Language Models
arxiv-2305-16349.creator: Qian Huang qhwang@cs.stanford.edu, Eric Zelikman ezelikman@cs.stanford.edu, Sarah Li Chen sachen@stanford.edu, Yuhuai Wu yuhuai@cs.stanford.edu, Gregory Valiant gvaliant@cs.stanford.edu, Percy Liang pliang@cs.stanford.edu
arxiv-2305-16349.description: Abstract Token embeddings, a mapping from discrete lexical symbols to continuous vectors, are at the heart of any language model (LM). However, lexical symbol meanings can also be determined and even redefined by their structural role in a long context. In this paper, we ask: is it possible for a language model to be performant without any fixed token embeddings?

arxiv-2310-05466.title: Geometry of the signed support of a multivariate polynomial and Descartes’ rule of signs
arxiv-2310-05466.creator: Máté L. Telek
arxiv-2310-05466.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Máté L. Telek. We investigate the signed support, that is, the set of the exponent vectors and the signs of the coefficients, of a multivariate polynomial f f . We describe conditions on the signed support ensuring that the semi-algebraic set, denoted as { f < 0 } \{f<0\} , containing points in the positive real orthant where f f takes negative values, has at most one connected component.

arxiv-2403-01854.title: Quantum counterdiabatic driving with local control
arxiv-2403-01854.creator: Changhao Li, Jiayu Shen, Ruslan Shaydulin, Marco Pistoia
arxiv-2403-01854.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Changhao Li, Jiayu Shen, Ruslan Shaydulin, Marco Pistoia. Suppression of diabatic transitions in quantum adiabatic evolution stands as a significant challenge for ground state preparations. Counterdiabatic driving has been proposed to compensate for diabatic losses and achieve shortcut to adiabaticity. However, its implementation necessitates the generation of adiabatic gauge potential, which requires knowledge of the spectral gap of instantaneous Hamiltonians and involves highly non-local drivings in many-body systems. In this work, we consider local counterdiabatic (LCD) driving with approximate adiabatic gauge potential.

arxiv-2504-07645.title: Prediction of Usage Probabilities of Shopping-Mall Corridors Using Heterogeneous Graph Neural Networks
arxiv-2504-07645.creator: Malik M. Barakathullah, Immanuel Koh
arxiv-2504-07645.description: Abstract We present a method based on graph neural network (GNN) for prediction of probabilities of usage of shopping-mall corridors. The heterogeneous graph network of shops and corridor paths are obtained from floorplans of the malls by creating vector layers for corridors, shops and entrances. These are subsequently assimilated into nodes and edges of graphs.

arxiv-2505-04065.title: Accelerated Gradient Methods Through Variable and Operator Splitting
arxiv-2505-04065.creator: Long Chen, Hao Luo, Jingrong Wei
arxiv-2505-04065.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Long Chen, Hao Luo, Jingrong Wei. This paper introduces a unified framework for accelerated gradient methods through the variable and operator splitting (VOS). The operator splitting decouples the optimization process into simpler subproblems, and more importantly, the variable splitting leads to acceleration. The key contributions include the development of strong Lyapunov functions to analyze stability and convergence rates, as well as advanced discretization techniques like Accelerated Over-Relaxation (AOR) and extrapolation by the predictor-corrector methods (EPC).

pmc-10534906.description: Simple SummaryHypersomatotropism results from excess growth hormone production by a pituitary tumour and represents an important underlying cause of diabetes mellitus in cats. The most well-validated assay (radioimmunoassay), however, requires facilities approved to handle radioactivity and is costly.

pmc-10538649.creator: Erika N Biernbaum, Rohana P Dassanayake, Eric M Nicholson, Indira T Kudva, Awatif Abid Al-Judaibi
pmc-10538649.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Shiga toxin-producing Escherichia coli (STEC) O157:H7 (O157) is a foodborne pathogen causing human disease ranging from hemorrhagic colitis and hemolytic uremic syndrome to kidney failure, while remaining harmless to cattle, its primary reservoir. The severity of the human disease associated mainly with Shiga toxin production and a global emergence of antibiotic resistant STEC highlights the need for effective non-antibiotic, pre-harvest strategies to reduce O157 in cattle, the principal source of human infection.

pmc-12571802.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionAmong the causes of cardiovascular diseases, abnormal blood pressure is especially significant. Blood pressure is a crucial hemodynamic biomarker of the cardiovascular health. Central aortic blood pressure correlates more closely with cardiovascular disease than peripheral arterial blood pressure. It can reflect the status of coronary arteries and aortas more directly and accurately, making it a significant tool for assessing cardiovascular risks. Invasive central aortic blood pressure measurement is considered the “gold standard” for evaluating left ventricular and coronary artery loads.

pmc-13095712.title: 外周免疫耐受在口腔疾病中的研究进展
pmc-13095712.creator: Keru WEN, Ping ZHANG, Xian PENG
pmc-13095712.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). 外周免疫耐受是机体维持免疫稳态的核心机制，其中调节性T细胞（regulatory T cells, Tregs）是执行该功能的关键细胞，通过细胞接触依赖、分泌抑制性细胞因子及代谢干扰等途径，Tregs主动抑制效应性免疫细胞的活化。在口腔局部环境中，Treg/辅助性T细胞17（T helper cell 17, Th17）轴的动态平衡对于维持口腔健康至关重要，是多种口腔疾病的共同免疫病理基础。在牙周炎中，Th17细胞过度活化和Tregs功能抑制驱动慢性破坏性炎症和牙槽骨吸收；在口腔扁平苔藓和复发性阿弗他溃疡等黏膜病中，Treg/Th17轴紊乱导致病理性自身免疫攻击；在口腔鳞状细胞癌中，肿瘤微环境通过招募Tregs建立异常免疫耐受，介导免疫逃逸并促进肿瘤进展。基于这些发现，旨在精准调控Tregs功能或重塑Treg/Th17平衡的治疗策略正在兴起，包括细胞因子调节剂、小分子药物、工程化Tregs细胞疗法等。然而，目前研究仍面临Tregs异质性机制不明、临床转化中靶向效率与安全性难以兼得等瓶颈。未来需结合多组学技术深入解析口腔微环境中的免疫调控网络，开发精准递送系统以推动临床转化。本文系统综述了外周免疫耐受及Tregs在口腔疾病中的作用机制，深入分析了不同疾病中的免疫失调特征，并探讨了基于免疫耐受调控的治疗策略及其临床应用前景，以期为口腔疾病的精准免疫治疗提供理论依据。Keywords: 外周免疫耐受, 调节性T细胞, 辅助性T细胞17, 口腔疾病, 综述

2025年，诺贝尔生理学或医学奖授予美国科学家玛丽·布伦科（MARY E. BRUNKOW）、弗雷德·拉姆斯德尔（FREDERICK J. RAMSDELL）和日本科学家坂口志文（SHIMON SAKAGUCHI），以表彰他们发现了调节性T细胞（regulatory T cells, Tregs）及其在外周免疫耐受中的核心作用。这一荣誉不仅是对这种新细胞类型发现的肯定，更重要的是，它解决了一个长期困扰免疫学的核心悖论：免疫系统在拥有强大能力以识别和清除外来入侵者的同时，如何与自身组织和平共处。外周免疫耐受作为维持免疫稳态的关键调控机制，主要依赖Tregs通过多种途径主动抑制效应性免疫细胞的活化[1-2]。口腔作为人体与外界直接相通的门户，长期暴露于复杂的抗原环境，其局部免疫系统需维持一种既能抵御病原体又不攻击自身组织的动态平衡[3]。

近年来，随着对Treg/辅助性T细胞17（T helper cell 17, Th17）轴在免疫调节中作用认识的深入，这一平衡机制在口腔疾病中的重要性日益凸显。在不同口腔疾病中，该轴呈现出不同的失衡模式：牙周炎表现为Th17主导的过度炎症反应，口腔黏膜病显示复杂的免疫紊乱特征，而口腔肿瘤则表现为Tregs介导的免疫抑制占优势。然而，目前Tregs在口腔微环境中的异质性及不同疾病中的特异性失调机制尚不明确，限制了精准免疫治疗策略的发展。本综述旨在系统阐述外周免疫耐受的生物学基础，深入分析其在主要口腔疾病中的失调特征，并探讨基于调控免疫耐受的治疗策略及临床转化前景，以期为口腔疾病的精准免疫干预提供理论依据。

外周免疫耐受与Tregs的生物学基础

外周免疫耐受是指在机体外周免疫系统中，通过Tregs等机制，主动抑制自身反应性T细胞的激活和扩增，从而防止自身免疫反应并维持免疫系统对自身抗原的无反应性[1]。Tregs作为这一过程的关键执行者，通过多种机制抑制效应性T细胞的活化和增殖，防止过度免疫反应[4-5]。

Tregs的发现

Tregs的发现经历了3个关键阶段：1995年，SAKAGUCHI等[6]在正常小鼠的外周免疫系统中鉴定出一类具有免疫抑制功能的CD4+CD25+ T细胞亚群，并发现该类细胞的耗竭会导致多种自身免疫疾病的发生。SAKAGUCHI[7]于2000年将其正式命名为Tregs。随后，RAMSDELL等与BRUNKOW等在2001年发现自身免疫病模型scurfy小鼠中存在Foxp3基因突变，并进一步证明人类Foxp3基因的突变会引起一种罕见的X染色体连锁自身免疫综合征（IPEX）[8-9]。2003年，SAKAGUCHI等通过构建Foxp3条件性敲除小鼠模型，并利用逆转录病毒介导的基因转移技术将Foxp3导入幼稚T细胞，发现Foxp3缺陷会导致Tregs发育失败并引发致命性自身免疫病，而Foxp3的表达能够将幼稚T细胞转化为具有调节功能的T细胞，从而表明Foxp3是Tregs发育的关键调节基因[10]。这3个阶段的研究不仅发现了一种新的细胞类型，更重要的是建立了理解外周免疫耐受的全新理论框架，为后续免疫相关疾病的研究和治疗奠定了坚实基础。

Tregs介导的免疫抑制机制

根据发育路径与起源的不同，Tregs主要分为胸腺Tregs（thymic regulatory T cells, tTregs）和外周Tregs（peripheral regulatory T cells, pTregs）两种亚型[4-5]。tTregs在胸腺中发育，经历自身抗原呈递诱导和细胞因子刺激等过程，成熟后分布于全身淋巴和非淋巴组织[11]。pTregs则在外周由常规T细胞在特定细胞因子、微生物代谢物等微环境作用下诱导形成，主要分布于肠道等黏膜部位，维持局部免疫稳态[12]。

Tregs通过多种机制发挥免疫抑制作用，主要包括细胞接触依赖性机制、细胞接触非依赖性机制和代谢干扰机制。细胞接触依赖机制主要通过高表达细胞毒T淋巴细胞相关抗原4（cytotoxic T lymphocyte-associated antigen-4, CTLA-4）等抑制性受体实现。CTLA-4能够与抗原呈递细胞（antigen-presenting cells, APCs）上的CD80/CD86结合，抑制T细胞的活化[13]。此外Tregs还能通过颗粒酶/穿孔素途径直接杀伤靶细胞[14]。细胞接触非依赖机制主要通过分泌免疫抑制性细胞因子实现远距离调控。Tregs分泌的转化生长因子-β（transforming growth factor-β, TGF-β）和白细胞介素（interleukin, IL）-10是两种最重要的抑制性细胞因子，直接作用于效应T细胞，抑制其增殖和活化[15-16]。代谢干扰机制是近年来发现的Tregs免疫抑制的重要途径。Tregs通过高表达CD39和CD73，进而水解腺嘌呤核苷三磷酸（adenosine triphosphate, ATP）产生腺苷，与A2A受体结合抑制T细胞活化[17]。此外，Tregs还能通过调控APCs功能间接抑制免疫应答[1,5]。这些机制并非孤立作用，而是在不同的组织微环境和疾病状态下协同发挥作用，共同维持免疫系统的动态平衡。

Treg/Th17轴失衡在牙周病中的作用

口腔环境中存在大量共生微生物，外周免疫耐受机制使得宿主能够在维持对共生菌耐受的同时，对病原菌保持免疫监视[18]。牙周病的发生原因之一正是这种免疫耐受状态被破坏，导致Treg/Th17轴比例失衡，转变为慢性炎症和组织破坏的结果[19]。

牙周炎的免疫反应机制

牙周炎是最常见和最严重的牙周病形式，其免疫机制涉及复杂的宿主免疫应答，包括固有免疫和适应性免疫两个方面[3]。固有免疫应答作为宿主对牙周细菌的第一反应，涉及巨噬细胞、中性粒细胞、树突状细胞以及补体系统等，能够迅速识别并响应入侵的病原体，释放炎症因子和细胞因子，导致牙龈血管扩张、通透性增加、免疫细胞浸润，从而引发牙龈炎症[20]。适应性免疫应答包括B细胞和T细胞对牙周病原菌产生的特异性免疫反应[21]。T细胞分为多种亚群，如Th1、Th2、Th17和Treg细胞，它们通过分泌不同的细胞因子调节炎症反应。例如，Th1细胞分泌干扰素γ（interferon-γ, IFN-γ），促进细胞介导的免疫反应；Th2细胞分泌IL-4、IL-5和IL-10，倾向于抑制炎症；Th17细胞分泌IL-17，与骨吸收和炎症加重有关；而Tregs则通过分泌TGF-β和IL-10抑制炎症反应[22]。

Treg/Th17轴失衡与牙周炎

Th17细胞是一类辅助性T细胞亚群，通过分泌促炎因子IL-17促进中性粒细胞募集和骨吸收，主要参与宿主防御和炎症反应[23]。研究表明，牙周炎患者的牙周组织中Th17细胞的比例显著增加，且IL-17的表达水平与牙周组织的炎症程度呈正相关[18-19]。Tregs通过高表达CTLA-4和分泌IL-10，能够抑制Th17细胞的活化和IL-17的产生，从而维持免疫平衡[24-25]。在健康状态下，Th17细胞主导的促炎反应和Tregs介导的免疫耐受共同维持免疫反应的动态平衡[26]。然而在牙周病中，Th17细胞的过度活化和Tregs的功能抑制导致了Treg/Th17轴的失衡，进而造成炎症反应的加剧和牙周组织的破坏，且研究表明可以通过调节Treg/Th17失衡来预防牙周炎[27-28]。

尽管Treg/Th17轴失衡的机制尚未完全明确，但可能涉及多种因素。首先，牙龈卟啉单胞菌（Porphyromonas gingivalis, P. g）及其毒力因子被发现能够激活Th17细胞[29-30]。此外也有研究发现P.

pmc-13240752.description: Cancer cells dynamically reprogram their metabolism to adapt to changing microenvironmental conditions during tumor growth and metastatic dissemination. pmc-13253882.title: Quality control of opportunistic multi-energy CT bone mineral density quantification
pmc-13253882.creator: Emily A. Thompson, Megan C. Jacobsen, Rachel M. Barbee, Jia Sun, Cayla A. Wood, Rick R. Layman
pmc-13253882.description: BackgroundAccurate assessment of bone mineral density (BMD) is crucial for evaluating bone loss in elderly and oncologic patients. Quantitative computed tomography (QCT) enables noninvasive quantification of patient BMD and can be performed opportunistically during routine CT examinations using either conventional or multi-energy CT (MECT). While both methods are used clinically, MECT can address limitations of conventional CT-based QCT.
